opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March for a decision in May

next_open_date.raw: 15 December for a decision in March

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects.
opportunities.summary: The grants are awarded as ‘seed funding’ to enable projects that might otherwise not be possible without support, aiming to deepen mutual understanding between the UK and Japan.
